newsitem.title: USA: SBC unit puts cellular service in Boston.
newsitem.headline: SBC unit puts cellular service in Boston.

text.p: Cellular One, a unit of SBC Communications Inc, said on Friday it has become the first wireless provider of digital cellular service in Boston, deploying its Cellular One Digital PCS there.
The digital personal communications systems, or PCS, doubles as a pager and message notification system with extended battery life and Caller ID capability, the company said.
Cellular One, together with its Southwestern Bell Mobile Systems affiliate, provides wireless communications to more than four million customers in 63 markets throughout the United States.
